title: cost-optimization: autotune defaults for batching/caching + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Jordan Lee
commits: a1b2c3: feat(autotune): add heuristics engine for suggested batching/caching defaults
d4e5f6: perf(runtime): wire in quantization profile selection based on workload fingerprint
0a1b2c: tool(uecon): expose per-route unit economics endpoint and CLI export
3d4e5f: docs: explain autotune defaults and how to interpret unit-econ reports
6f7g8h: test: add integration tests for batching suggestions and quant profile fallbacks
description: Motivation: reduce customer unit cost by providing safe, opinionated defaults and actionable unit-economics tooling. This PR wires an autotune heuristics engine that suggests batching and caching defaults per workload fingerprint, adds a curated set of quantization profiles and selection logic, and surfaces per-route unit economics in both the control plane API and CLI. Key points: 1) Heuristics engine collects lightweight telemetry (seq length distribution, request concurrency, response size) and computes suggested batch_size, max_latency_slo and prefix-cache policies. Suggestions are conservative and annotated with expected token-cost delta to avoid regressions. 2) Quantization profiles: introduce profiles.yaml (q4_k_mixed, q8_2, fp16_fallback) and runtime logic to pick the best compatible profile given model architecture + HW. Runtime falls back to a safe profile on mismatch. 3) Unit-econ tooling: new /api/v1/uecon route and cli uecon export to produce per-route cost/latency reports, and a small CSV export to feed downstream billing/optimization. 4) Observability: instrumented key metrics and a new console doc explaining decision rationale and how to apply suggestions. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is unchanged until tenant opts-in to suggestions or the new auto-apply flag. Testing: added integration tests that simulate bursty and steady workloads, and CI checks to validate profile selection matrix. Related: ENG-1223 (autotune roadmap), ENG-1301 (quant profiles), PM-456 (unit-econ feature).
review_comments: Priya: Can we make the heuristics sampling window configurable per-tenant? Also asked for more detail on how we ensure suggestions won't increase tail latency.
Author reply: Added tenant sampling window in deploy/helm/values-autotune.yaml and added conservative tail-latency guard (requests flagged if 95th > SLO).
Evan: Please add a fallback plan if quant profile selection picks an unsupported kernel on older drivers.
Author reply: Added explicit kernel-compat checks; runtime will fallback to fp16_fallback and emit a metric 'quant_fallback' for alerting.
Luis: Unit-econ CSV format looks good but can we include model-version and region tags?
Author reply: Included model_version and region columns in the CLI export and API response.
Priya (approve): Tests and docs look solid. Recommend squash-merge once CI passes.
release_notes: Adds autotune suggestions for batching and caching, quantization profile management, and a unit-economics API/CLI for per-route cost reporting. Default behavior unchanged unless enabled via tenant settings. See console docs for usage and safety guidelines.
